== Description ==

Eight players outside the venue, Zu den Vier Winden in Bochum, on the final day of the [[2024 World Championship]]. Second from left is [[Dan Tartaglione]] in his cyan-and-black plaid shirt, and fifth from left is [[Patrik Csapi]] (long dark hair, full beard, black "Baba Yaga" T-shirt). The other six are not yet identified.
